title: Everything Invisible
body:
📖 Mod Overview

Have you ever wondered what the world would look like if you were the only "visible" being left? Everything Invisible is a lightweight functional mod that goes beyond simply applying invisibility potion effects. It severs biological rendering and feedback at the system level, completely "erasing" entities from both your sight and hearing.

✨ Core Features
Physical-Level Invisibility: All entities (animals, monsters, villagers, etc.) are completely invisible in your field of view.

Particle Clearance: Thoroughly removes potion particles from entities, preventing "floating bubbles" from giving away a mob's position.

Absolute Silence: Disables all non-player entity ambient and hurt sounds for a truly ghostly experience.

Precise Exclusion: This mod does not affect players. You remain fully visible to yourself, ensuring your gameplay and movement remain intuitive.

🛠 Technical Specifications
Low-Level Rendering Optimization: Implemented via Mixin technology; it does not modify entity data directly, ensuring your save files remain safe.

High Performance: Utilizing Fabric's Split Client/Common source sets, this mod has a negligible impact on system performance.

No "Pseudo-Effects": Since this is not achieved through potion effects, it cannot be cleared by milk, and no status icons will clutter your HUD.

------------------

📖 模组简介

你是否想过，如果整个世界只剩下你一个“可见”的对象，会是怎样的景象？ 《万物隐形》 是一款轻量化的功能性模组。它并非简单地给生物附加隐身药水效果，而是从系统底层切断了生物的渲染与反馈，将它们完全从你的视觉和听觉中“抹除”。

✨ 核心功能
物理级隐身：所有的生物（动物、怪物、村民等）在视野中完全不可见。

粒子净空：彻底去除生物身上的药水粒子效果，防止“浮空粒子”暴露怪物位置。

绝对静谧：禁用了所有非玩家生物的待机音效和受击音效。

精准排除：本模组功能不作用于玩家。你依然可以清晰地看到自己，确保操作体验不受影响。

🛠 技术特性
渲染底层优化：基于 Mixin 技术实现，不直接修改实体数据，不影响存档安全。

极简兼容：由于采用了 Fabric 的源码集分离，本模组性能损耗极低。

不使用伪效果：并非通过药水实现，因此不会被牛奶清除，也不会有药水图标干扰。
